statement: ∀ p q : Ambient n × ℝ, dist (appendCoord n p) (appendCoord n q) ^ 2 = dist p.1 q.1 ^ 2 + dist p.2 q.2 ^ 2
proof:
intro p q
rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
simp [appendCoord]
